protocol: Two paired rounds 1/3 then 3/1. 5 warm-up jobs excluded. 100 replay jobs/stage by default; fixed 8 producers; one bounded observer polls outstanding jobs once per second. 200 GETs/stage after completion. This is a short burst, not sustained capacity.
limits: Two e2-standard-2 nodes; application limit 0.5 CPU and 384Mi each; shared single PostgreSQL and RabbitMQ; external client latency included.
interpretation: Higher burst throughput observed; only two rounds, not proportional scaling or sustained capacity.
